validation_order.name: canonical_digest_scope_source_binding
validation_order.required: canonical receipt bytes, digest, scope, source-version and replay-field structure

validation_order.name: trust_anchor_load
validation_order.required: pinned root fingerprint and declared policy

validation_order.name: path_build_and_certificate_constraints
validation_order.required: root to intermediate to leaf chain, issuer, AKI/SKI, basicConstraints, keyUsage, EKU, nameConstraints, policy, validity, algorithms, critical extensions

validation_order.name: receipt_signature
validation_order.required: leaf signature over exact canonical receipt digest

validation_order.name: revocation
validation_order.required: CRL or OCSP as-of and freshness decision

validation_order.name: trusted_time
validation_order.required: RFC3161 or equivalent independent signed time

validation_order.name: replay_ledger
validation_order.required: nonce, sequence, idempotency and replay-window decision

validation_order.name: authority_decision
validation_order.required: closed decision enum; no terminal authority emission

trust_anchor.source_of_authority: external owner or independent trust administrator; not local source authors
trust_anchor.recovery: provide immutable fingerprint and independently confirm authorization and policy; changed input fingerprint required
trust_anchor.test_fixture_rule: TEST_ONLY fixture roots must be isolated and explicitly labelled; never loaded as production trust

required_extensions.name_constraints: must contain leaf identity and scope

intermediate.recovery: attestor supplies full chain and policy; independent verifier validates to pinned root

leaf.private_key: never accepted as repository or receipt input
leaf.recovery: provide public certificate fingerprint and signed scope statement; independent reviewer confirms identity/conflict boundary

revocation_unavailable_mapping.note: external service missing/untrusted is not a certificate contradiction; revoked/invalid/expired response remains fail_closed

test_only_profile.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 deterministic JSON, recursively sorted keys, no whitespace, no terminal LF

production_profile.recovery: external contract owner must supply exact versioned values; null/placeholder/test OIDs are never accepted as production policy

rotation.rule: rotation changes the input fingerprint; old receipts are immutable and are not silently revalidated under a new root
